summary: Frontend-only LeadPilot AI SaaS mock app tested end-to-end. All critical flows working: landing (hero + CTAs + theme toggle), signup->onboarding->dashboard, login->2FA->dashboard, forgot-password success state, all 11 dashboard pages (Dashboard, Leads, Research, Emails, Calls, Meetings, CRM, Analytics, Automation, Knowledge Base, Integrations, Settings), sidebar nav, top navbar (theme, notifications, profile, global search command palette), floating AI Assistant panel with message input/send, and logout back to /. Dashboard shows 8 stat cards, engagement chart, AI recommendations. Feature-specific interactive controls verified (generate-leads-btn, tone/subject selectors, voice-selector, end-call-btn, confirm-booking-btn, add-deal-btn, export-btn, zoom-in/out, kb-ask-btn, integration toggles, settings tabs). No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request references data-testid 'nav-knowledge' but implementation derives testid from label 'Knowledge Base' => 'nav-knowledge-base'. Not a bug (consistent testid generation), just an inconsistency in the review request spec. All other sidebar testids match.

The Emergent preview badge (#emergent-badge) is a fixed anchor that can intercept pointer events over the bottom-right floating AI FAB during automated testing. Real users can still click through (browsers with normal focus). Consider adding pointer-events:none to the badge, or increasing the FAB z-index above the badge to avoid CI flake.
test_credentials: Mocked - prefilled alex@vertexlabs.io / password; any 6-digit OTP for 2FA.
seed_data_creation: None - app uses static mock data in src/lib/mockData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app with mocked data — no backend. All buttons produce toasts/navigation/state changes. When automating clicks near bottom-right (AI FAB, upgrade button), hide the Emergent badge (#emergent-badge) or use force=True — otherwise it intercepts pointer events. Sidebar nav testids are generated from label lowercased with hyphens (e.g., 'Knowledge Base' -> nav-knowledge-base).
